name: 24914-fp8kvdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1. An 8B checkpoint fits one 80 GB card and no parallelism flag is set.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, bounded at 100 requests / 900 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion. Seed static 24914.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket. Prompt EXACTLY 1000 tokens and output EXACTLY 200, so every request is the same size. Greedy (temperature 0.0). No prefix is shared between requests.
purpose: An 8B-parameter chat assistant serving one user at a time, with page-long prompts and short replies, on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml (NOT portable, per-machine).

# Ungated mirror of a gated repo; same weights.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

kv-cache-dtype: fp8

# Prefix caching is ON by default on this engine, so this line does real work, and it is a VALIDITY
# condition: a cache hit changes how many prompt tokens a request actually prefills, so the
# per-request work stops matching the declared prompt length and latencies stop being comparable.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# ONE LINE OF INLINE JSON, NOT A BLOCK MAPPING, AND THAT IS LOAD-BEARING: the reader of this file
# skips indented lines, so written block-style the key parses to nothing, the engine launches on
# its own default compile config, and it still reports rc=0.
compilation-config: {"compile_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8], "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8], "cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# enforce-eager MUST STAY ABSENT: the compilation config above is part of the declared setup,
# so an engine run eagerly is not running this setup.
